notes.title: Patch with fixes!
notes.notes:
It's been more than a week since the release, we've received indispensable feedback and prepared a patch fixing typos and some technical issues.

What's changed:
- fixed typos
- fixed minor errors in images
- added font size selection (if you used ren py font settings and now the font is displayed incorrectly - you need to go to the settings and reset to the original values)

Now we are working on proofreading English text and the possibility to add other languages!
Thank you for being with us and leaving your feedback!

notes.title: The release day!
notes.notes:
The release day has arrived!
We are pleased to present our mystical story that will definitely not leave you indifferent. Help Aki break the curse and decide her fate!

Our team is very fond of mystical horrors and we tried to carry over the spirit of high school horror stories and creepypastas. Every bad ending is like a unique creepypasta, and we recommend reading all of them!

Is it possible to change the fate of the heroines? Read «Graces: Posthumous Wish» and find out!

notes.title: Release on November 20th!
notes.notes:
Graces: Posthumous Wish releases on November 20th!

With less than a week to go, we are pretty excited and make all preparations for the release of our mystery novel where scary ghost tales intertwine with the dramatic stories of heroines.

Soon the mystery of Mitsuki's death will be solved!
